products.title: Lineaire Drop Earrings - Silver
products.body_html:
LINÉAIRE ET LUMINEUX

The Linéaire Emerald + Pear Drop Earrings are a study in light and structure, showcasing emerald-cut and pear-cut cubic zirconia in a clean bezel setting. Elongated facets catch and reflect light, echoing architectural lines.

Will arrive beautifully packaged in our branded gift box.

  • Crafted from 925 sterling silver
  • AAA-quality emerald and pear cut cubic zirconia stones
  • Drop length approximately 1.5cm
  • 6mm in width
  • Midweight design, each earring weighs approximately 1.8g
  • Nickel-free & hypoallergenic

To maintain original lustre, we recommend that you remove these earrings before swimming, bathing and sleeping.

products.body_html:

Designed with an open-ended silhouette and malleability, it can be gently shaped for a tailored fit against the collarbone. Crafted as a limited-edition statement piece that balances elegance and contemporary artistry.

To maintain original lustre, we recommend that you remove this choker before swimming, bathing and sleeping.
